fields.acceptance: go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/docs-' passes (links resolve, named commands exist), README.md no longer says pages are on the way, and the owner approves the page at the run's sign-off
fields.statement: README.md reads in the owner's voice (drafted with the humanize skill) and its where-next section links the docs that exist (quickstart, concepts, agents, runs and the daemon, custom workflows, the generated reference) instead of saying they are on the way

fields.acceptance: go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/quickstart passes with the page's new commands, docs/quickstart.md contains no {"writes" JSON, and the owner approves the page at the run's sign-off
fields.statement: docs/quickstart.md reads in the owner's voice and writes the capabilities, the decision and the decided-by link with plain rhiza add and rhiza link commands; rhiza apply gets one short mention as the way to write several things at once or from an agent, with no JSON file in the walkthrough
